decisions.intent: Audit the desktop document-bottom backlinks and mentions panel against S-Forge's separate Editor and Backlink domain roots.
notes: The upstream behavior introduces a desktop-only editor setting, lazy bottom-panel mounting at document EOF, document changes and dirty refresh, nested Protyle focus routing, and disposal.

Candidate 135723ceb1f1b78dc7d5c453f4b9981bfb5cd10c has already modeled shared Backlink toolbar control state with Zod/CaliburRouter and reports content-free intent at existing toolbar, filter, sort-menu, and tree-result user boundaries. The focused router test passed 2 assertions; filtered full typecheck output was empty for the new paths.

The next lifecycle stage adds the bottom-specific control state and reports content-free intent only at actual user boundaries: setting toggle, panel control, result expand/collapse, and result navigation; refresh and rendering paths must not fabricate user intent.

The final decision remains withheld until the EditorDomain and BacklinkDomain compatibility checks, focused lifecycle/router tests, configuration persistence, and desktop runtime evidence are complete.
